what: A preview of a published agenda, for notice. An agenda lists what MAY be discussed; nothing here predicts an outcome. Every agenda_line is verbatim from the document.

preview.how_to_attend: Header says Remote – Zoom Only, though the boilerplate also mentions in-person attendance. Join by Zoom at https://us02web.zoom.us/j/9091740347?omn=87352897617 or phone (888) 475-4499, Meeting ID 909 174 0347. Also broadcast on Lunenburg Public Access and Facebook Live.

items.agenda_line: a. Request for Finance Reserve Funding –
items.why_it_matters: The committee will take up a request for Finance Reserve funds, tied to reconciling the FY26 School Department budget and reviewing the FY27 school budget and financial operations.

items.agenda_line: a. Special Town Meeting Warrant Articles
items.why_it_matters: The committee may discuss the articles on the warrant for the Special Town Meeting listed for Nov 17, 2026, which could include spending requests.
The committee may discuss the town's financial policies, which guide how money is handled.

preview.hook: School reserve-fund request and FY26 school budget reconciliation, Special Town Meeting articles, and financial policies
preview.one_line: Finance Committee, Nov 12, 7 PM on Zoom: a Finance Reserve request tied to school budgets, Special Town Meeting warrant articles, and financial policies.
